cases.name: Christine Marie Conley Andrews
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Christine graduated from Allegany High School in 1992 where she was active in cheerleading. She devoted her life to being a full-time mother to her three beautiful daughters, Faith, Jordan and Sara. Christine attended all of Faith’s Allegany Arrowette performances and all of Jordan and Sara’s competitions as members of the Allegany High School Color Guard. She was a member of St. Mary’s Church at Our Lady of the Mountains Parish. She also loved spending time with her family and friends."
